stops.note: a bundle of rods carried before Roman magistrates as a symbol of authority
stops.meaning: a bundle of rods, symbol of authority

stops.note: literally 'bundle', applied to political associations and unions
coined for Mussolini's authoritarian nationalist movement, consciously invoking Roman imagery
borrowed for the movement and, later, the broader ideology it named

current_meaning: a far-right, authoritarian political ideology and movement
